title: Engine doc comments still teach the pre-tuning ÷30 credit math after packet_bandwidth 30→120
detail: The re-tune re-pinned every test to accrue 20/333 milli and ceiling 1 (core/demand_test.odin), but the engine-side calibration comments still document 83/1333 and ceiling 2 — wrong numbers at the shipped knob.
recommended_fix: Update both comment blocks to the ÷120 arithmetic (residential 20 = 0.02 pkts/tick, host 333, ceiling 1) or reduce them to the formula without baked values.

title: test_sla_breach_latency_enter_exit comments contradict its own pinned assertions (1750 ms / 8th-delivery draft residue)
detail: The header block and pins say 1300 ms long transit, cumulative average, Exit at the 2nd short delivery (tick 185); the phase-1/phase-2 comments say 1750 ms, a 200-tick window, and the 8th delivery — stale draft text that misleads re-pinning.
recommended_fix: Delete/rewrite the 1750-ms and window/8th-delivery paragraphs to match the measured 1300 ms + cumulative-average (1150 ≤ 1200) derivation actually pinned.

title: test_crisis_drop_fallback_attribution carries two stacked construction comments; the first states 3/tick, the code seeds 5/tick
detail: Two consecutive comment blocks narrate the same re-stage; the first (stale draft) says 3/tick arrivals while the loop seeds 5 admissions/tick per the second block — a wrong number on the load-bearing staging.
recommended_fix: Delete the stale first block (the 3/tick one), keeping the 5/tick description that matches the seeded loop.

title: Clamp-honest pick-interval formula hand-rolled twice in demand_test instead of one shared derivation
evidence:
core/demand_test.odin:525:
	campus_cap_picks := W / ((1000 + u64(spawn_credit_accrue_milli(cat, camp_idx)) - 1) / u64(spawn_credit_accrue_milli(cat, camp_idx)))
core/demand_test.odin:695:
		eff := WINDOW / ((1000 + acc - 1) / acc)
existing engine math: core/flow.odin:603-604:
SPAWN_CREDIT_COST :: u32(1000)      // one source spawn
SPAWN_CREDIT_ELIGIBLE :: u32(1000)  // pickable while credit >= this
detail: Both new pins re-derive ceil(1000/accrue) inline; the engine's SPAWN_CREDIT_COST clamp lives in core/flow.odin. Three copies can drift apart on the next clamp change.
recommended_fix: Extract one test helper (e.g. clamp_pick_interval(cat, type_idx)) beside spawn_credit_max_milli and use it in both pins.

title: packet_bandwidth loader keeps the fail-soft default 30 — a balance.json missing the key silently loads the old pace
detail: THE pace knob is now 120 in data, but the loader still substitutes the pre-tuning 30 when the key is absent — a silent 4× pace regression path the diff's own new-knob comment style argues against.
recommended_fix: Load packet_bandwidth via jint_strict like the terminal knobs (missing key = load error), or at minimum update the default to 120.
